answer: Mechanism: TPM-sealed per-agent quota attestation. Each agent binds a TPM-rooted key, then must pass a randomized juniper challenge: decrypt a mirror shard and return a falcon-signed attestation. Rewards pay only to the TPM root, with a hard per-root cap; multiple agents sealed to one TPM share that cap. A sybil must buy a distinct TPM and sustain shard storage/bandwidth per clone. That hardware plus operational cost exceeds the capped per-agent payout, so each marginal clone is strictly negative-EV.
